secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Long random string used to sign auth tokens. Required at boot — app exits without it.

secrets.name: MONGODB_URI
secrets.description: MongoDB connection string. Overridden in the sandbox to point at the local compose mongo service; set your Atlas URI for production.

secrets.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
secrets.description: Username for the auto-created admin account.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Password for the auto-created admin account.

secrets.name: ADMIN_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Separate secret key required at admin login.

secrets.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Razorpay API key ID. Needed for payment checkout endpoints.

secrets.name: RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET
secrets.description: Razorpay API key secret. Needed for payment checkout endpoints.

secrets.name: RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Razorpay webhook signing secret. Needed only for the webhook endpoint.

secrets.name: B2_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Backblaze B2 application key ID. Optional — B2 is used lazily for uploads.

secrets.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
secrets.description: Backblaze B2 application key. Optional — B2 is used lazily for uploads.

secrets.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
secrets.description: Backblaze B2 bucket name. Optional — B2 is used lazily for uploads.
